name: shrike-security
description: Runtime enforcement for Claude Code: scans commands, file writes, notebook edits, web searches and fetches with Shrike before they execute (allow / warn / require approval / block), records what Claude Code's own permission layer decided beside Shrike's verdict, and bundles the governed-tool-use skill plus the shrike-mcp security tools.

api_key.title: Shrike API key
api_key.description: Enables enforcement. Without a key the hook installs but governs nothing. Free key at https://shrikesecurity.com
